incident-bot: INCIDENT — continuous-batching perf cliff detected in us-east-1; error spike and queueing observed. auto-pager to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
lee: seeing 95th/p99 token latency jump, queues growing on worker pool 'cont-batcher-7'
anika: confirmed — kvcache miss rate up ~10x, eviction storms in logs, microbatch sizes oscillating
matt: impact? partner-api reporting increased 5xxs (alerts from customer-monitoring)
simone: dashboards show request backlog +300k tokens, tail latency 6.2s -> 18s, throughput down ~40%
lee: paging oncall (kai) — @kai are you on?
kai: oncall here, joining. looking at controller metrics now. what's the suspected vector?
anika: hypothesis: a prefetch/pinning change in the last config rollout increased cache churn; under high concurrency the continuous-batcher compacts and causes requeue loops
matt: logs show repeated `batcher: requeue attempt=4 reason=cache_miss` and `kvclient: eviction-threshold-triggered`
simone: also observed microbatch size oscillation: briefly drops to 1 then spikes to 64 — that pattern thrashes the kvcache (hot keys get evicted then repopulated)
lee: quick mitigation ideas: 1) force fixed microbatch cap (max=8), 2) temporarily disable prefetch/pinning, 3) increase kvcache capacity/TTL — 3 requires infra change
kai: ok apply 1 + 2 as a hotfix immediately; we'll consider 3 if situation persists
anika: rolling runtime config change (canary) -> `continuous_batch.max_microbatch=8`, `prefetch.enabled=false`
deploy-bot: deploy started by anika to env=production-us-east-1 config=cb-hotfix-1749802468 :rocket:
matt: can we also revert the kvcache.policy change from the 6h rollout? that was the only other diff
simone: full revert is disruptive. let's validate hotfix impact first and then decide
kai: agreed. hotfix -> monitor 5m, if stable escalate to controlled revert plan
anika: patch applied to 10% nodes (canary), logs streaming to #eng-oncall
incident-bot: ALERT: canary nodes healthy after 90s — 95th latency down ~30% on canary
lee: increase canary to 50% if no regressions. simone, watch errors/backlog closely
simone: bumping canary -> 50% now
deploy-bot: canary scaled to 50%
matt: customer impact: `partner-api` had ~18% 503s during the peak window; ops should draft a short blurb for comms
kai: post-canary metrics: avg latency down to 9s from 18s, queue length trending down
anika: prepare rollback play just in case: `kubectl apply -f cb-default.yaml` then `circleci run rollback-job --env us-east-1` — docs updated in incident runbook
lee: good. mark as `mitigated` if stable for 10 min; else escalate to infra and SRE
simone: follow-up: add a guard in runtime to prevent microbatch oscillation when prefetch toggles (suggested patch in eng-runtime)
matt: I'll notify growth/product/comms about the degradation window and draft the customer note
kai: handing off to night oncall @lee — I'll remain on Slack for 15m for quick questions
lee: acknowledged. creating postmortem stub and assigning owners
simone: archived logs and trace links: /var/logs/incidents/1749802468 and traces.s3/redwood/1749802468
matt: small ops note — need an alert to correlate kvcache eviction spikes with batcher requeues (create alert rule)
anika: added a temporary grafana panel and alert to the incident dashboard
lee: patch validated on 50% canary, global rollout in progress, backlog returning to normal :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, mitigation=cb-config-hotfix, started_by=anika, note="canary->50% healthy, monitoring 10m"
